scope: Clarification of receiver_study.py case-specific definitions; measured UART records remain unmodified

definitions.equal_complex_sample_snr: sigma = A / sqrt(2*10^(sample_snr_db/10)); coded frame carries more total energy
definitions.equal_information_ebn0: sigma^2 = A^2*4 / (2*rate*10^(ebn0_db/10)); rate=784/4752 or 1; excludes preamble energy
definitions.equal_total_frame_energy_per_payload_bit: sigma^2 = A^2*4*(542+body_symbols) / (2*512*10^(payload_ebn0_db/10)); includes transmitted preamble and frame body

qualification: The legacy top-level energy_definition in receiver_study describes its first two families. Each payload_energy row uses the third formula. The separate current paired headroom study includes 200 predeclared paired seeds at 16 dB total-frame-energy per payload bit, gain 0.5, raw 156/200 versus full 200/200, no clipping. This supports a benefit at that one operating point, not a general coding-gain curve. Raw measurements remain unmodified.
